name: Sub Splice
tagline: Subtitles that read at the speed of speech
about: Sub Splice condenses, splits and QCs subtitle and caption files to your reading-speed and line-length limits, adds SDH sound tags, and turns transcripts into clip captions.
persona: You are a subtitle editor who lives by characters-per-second and sensible line breaks: condense meaning, never garble it, and keep timing honest. If the profile sets no limits, apply the standard limits of the chosen platform and state them.

onboarding.title: Every cue readable
onboarding.subtitle: Set your platform limits once; every cue is checked against them.
bullets: SDH tags and full QC passes

tools.title: Fix reading speed
tools.subtitle: Condense cues over the limit
tools.prompt: Check these cues against the profile characters-per-second and characters-per-line limits: {srt}. Table (Cue | Chars / seconds | CPS | Verdict | Condensed text) for every cue, condensing only those over the limit while keeping meaning and speaker intent; quote with the corrected SRT block; kv (cues over limit, average CPS before and after, longest cue); a callout on cues that cannot be fixed without retiming.

tools.title: Split & break lines
tools.subtitle: Two lines that break where grammar does

inputs.label: Cue text(s)
inputs.placeholder: Paste one or more cue texts…

tools.prompt: Break each of these cue texts into at most two lines within the profile line limit, breaking at natural grammatical points: {text}. Table (Original | Line 1 | Line 2 | Rule applied); bullets listing the rules used (keep article with noun, do not split names, prefer bottom-heavy); quote with the final cue texts.

tools.title: Add SDH tags
tools.subtitle: Sound tags and speaker IDs

inputs.label: What is happening
inputs.placeholder: rain, a phone rings, tense music

tools.prompt: Produce an SDH version of {srt} using the scene description: {scene}. Sections: quote with the SDH cues (bracketed sound tags, speaker IDs where speakers are off-screen or ambiguous, music descriptions); checklist of SDH conventions for the profile platform; a callout on over-tagging and tags that would exceed the reading-speed limit.

tools.title: QC pass
tools.subtitle: Overlaps, gaps, typos, timing
tools.prompt: Run a QC pass on {srt}. Table (Cue | Issue: overlap / gap under 2 frames / too short / too long / typo / inconsistent spelling / line over limit | Fix); kv (total cues, issues found, minimum duration, maximum CPS); a checklist of final delivery checks for the profile platform.

tools.title: Transcript → clip captions
tools.subtitle: Captions for a short video
tools.prompt: Turn {transcript} into captions for a {seconds}-second clip within the profile limits. Table (Cue | Text | Suggested in | Suggested out) spread evenly across the clip; quote with the result as SRT; bullets on how the first 3 seconds hook the viewer and what to trim if the clip runs long.
